name: WordSeek
description: Wordle-style word game bot for Telegram - solo & multiplayer rounds, daily challenge, leaderboards, moderation.

ADMIN_USERS.description: Telegram User IDs of bot admins (comma-separated)

DAILY_WORDLE_SECRET.description: Long random string salt for the daily word rotation. Strongly recommended: without it, future daily words can be precomputed from the public word list. A random secret is generated automatically if left blank.

WEB_SERVICE.description: Set false for worker-style long polling on Heroku

REDIS_URI.description: Valkey/Redis connection string. Optional: the Heroku Key-Value Store add-on injects REDIS_URL, which is used automatically when this is unset.
